title: Blepharoplasty, Blepharoptosis Repair, and Brow Lift
jurisdiction: CMS Hospital Outpatient Prior Authorization (42 CFR § 419.80)
description: CMS prior authorization requirement for functional blepharoplasty and repair of blepharoptosis. Mandates documented superior visual field restriction of at least 30% or 12 degrees, photographic documentation showing pseudoptosis or lid margin reflex distance, and subjective visual impairment during activities of daily living.

change_log.author: CMS MCD
change_log.summary: Annual OPD prior authorization transmittal update.

criteria.name: Visual Field Restriction (>= 30% or 12 Degrees)
criteria.description: Goldmann or automated visual field testing demonstrating superior visual field restriction of >= 30% or 12 degrees of field loss with lids un-taped.
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide

criteria.name: Marginal Reflex Distance 1 (MRD1 <= 2.0 mm)
criteria.description: Photographic measurement showing Marginal Reflex Distance 1 (MRD1) <= 2.0 mm, or skin overhang resting on the eyelashes in primary gaze.
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide

criteria.name: Purely Cosmetic Eyelid Surgery Exclusion
criteria.description: Procedure performed solely for cosmetic appearance without documented functional visual field restriction or symptomatic visual impairment.
criteria.clinical_intent: Statutory exclusion of purely cosmetic rejuvenation
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide
